name: PasteCode
summary: Pastebin alternative for sharing and saving text and code, built with Next.js Server Components and shadcn/ui.
description: A pastebin-style web app for sharing and saving text and code snippets. The stack is TypeScript, Next.js with React Server Components, shadcn/ui and TailwindCSS, with Drizzle ORM over NeonDB, oRPC for the API layer and Shiki for syntax highlighting. MIT licensed, with a hosted demo at pastecodeapp.vercel.app.
contains: share and save text and code pastes
built with TypeScript, Next.js (RSC), shadcn/ui and TailwindCSS
Drizzle ORM over NeonDB with an oRPC API layer
